INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.

2. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.

5. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

6. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
